hypothesis: A required_documents value changed into a delimited list is rejected even though every item occurs in order in a valid source evidence paragraph. Restore the full source paragraph only when it explicitly requests preparing documents.
scope: Required documents field, source-alignment repair only. No model, prompt or QA-validator changes.
gates: Each of at least two document-like list items must occur verbatim and in order in the model evidence.
Evidence must map to one unique source paragraph; output copies that entire original paragraph.
Reject changed or added items, order reversal, repeated matches, unsupported attachments and non-obligatory reference text.
Full Python regression, paired replay of all five saved public-v12 outputs and a new isolated real five-page API run before deployment.
limits: Existing development cases, not independent held-out test.
Generic references to other required documents do not establish a complete list.
Keep costs, conditions, source qualifiers and known semantic limitations visible.
No training or use of the reserved training experiment test.
